hook: Soap scum tiles wipe clean with this.
doThis: Warm white vinegar on ceramic tiles.

steps.say: Dust or vacuum loose hair first.
Spray warm white vinegar. Not on natural stone.
Wipe, rinse, then dry so spots don't return.

safety.say: Never use vinegar on marble, and don't mix it with bleach.
safety.text: No vinegar on stone. Never mix bleach.

result.say: Tiles that actually look clean again.
result.headline: Tiles look new
